title: Console observability triage scratchpad - Aisha (follow-up)
content:
Context / Summary:
- Follow-up scratchpad for console/observability triage after initial customer report. Working notes, repros, and action list.
- Focus: missing per-route latency p95 on Console > Routes for /payments and potential label relabeling during infra change.

Customer report recap (Feb 24):
- AcmeFinance (Dedicated) reported blank p95 between ~03:10-03:45 UTC for /payments (OBS-321).
- Provided screenshot + timeframe.

What I observed: 
- Grafana panel 'routes:latency-p95' showed NaN for that window.
- Raw metric series present but labeled '/payments:legacy' from 03:08 onward.
- SRE notes show pod restart in dedicated pool at ~03:06 and small infra routing config push at 03:05 (PR #1248).

Hypotheses:
- Relabel rules change in PR #1248 caused metric label to flip to canonical_name -> '/payments:legacy'.
- Short-lived fallback routing or exporter edge-case emitted alternate tag during cache fallback.

Actions taken so far:
- Queried metrics API and confirmed '/payments:legacy' series exists for the timeframe.
- Reviewed PR #1248 diff: relabel_rules updated to prefer canonical_name if present.
- Opened OBS-322 to track exporter handling of dual tag during transitions.

Immediate mitigation (short-term):
- Patch panels to OR-match both '/payments' OR '/payments:legacy' to restore visualization. Will note as temporary. Owner: Aisha. ETA: today EOD.
- Ask dashboards team to review templating variable behavior (Grafana template vars may break if we add OR). If templating breaks, fallback plan: add per-route panel for /payments.

Follow-ups (priority):
- [P0] Reproduce relabel behavior in staging by applying relabel change + synthetic traffic. Owner: Jordan. ETA: next day morning.
- [P1] Complete OBS-322 with logs, repro steps, and suggested exporter fix. Owner: Maya. ETA: next week.
- [P1] Coordinate with infra PR author about intent of relabel change and potential revert if unintended. Owner: infra-contact (cc: me).
- [P2] Add integration test for relabel rules to catch silent metric renames. Owner: infra-team.

Investigation checklist (next steps):
- grep metrics-exporter logs for 'route_tag' and 'canonical_name' between 02:50-03:20 UTC.
- Compare prometheus/remote-write relabel config snapshots (02:50 vs 03:10).
- Pull alert history to see if any alerts were suppressed due to label mismatch.

Commands/queries used: 
- curl -s "https://metrics-api.internal/v1/series?name=routes.latency.p95&start=2026-02-24T03:00:00Z&end=2026-02-24T04:00:00Z&match=route:\"/payments*\"" | jq .
- kubectl logs -n observability deploy/metrics-exporter --since=2h | rg "route_tag|canonical_name"
- git show origin/main:infra/configs/relabel_rules.yaml | sed -n '1,200p'

Communication drafts:
- Customer note (short): "We observed a temporary metrics relabeling during a small routing config change that changed the label name for /payments. The underlying metrics are intact. We're applying a temporary dashboard patch and will follow up with a permanent fix."
- Internal note: include timeline, PR #1248, SRE restart, and OBS-322 link.

Outstanding questions:
- Was PR #1248 intended to change metric labels or was this a side-effect? (Asked in PR comments.)
- Are other routes affected? Quick scan found '/subscriptions:legacy' as well -> may be multiple routes.
- Do any paging alert rules depend on exact label values? (Risk of missed pages.)

End-of-day checklist (my tasks):
- [ ] Deploy temporary dashboard query OR patch to staging, validate, then prod.
- [ ] Confirm OBS-322 includes logs + repro steps.
- [ ] Send customer update via CS with workaround.
- [ ] Follow up with PR #1248 author for next steps.

Notes to self:
- Keep scratchpad concise; move finalized incident timeline to Confluence (pageId 987654).
- If rollback needed, coordinate with SRE to avoid APAC business hour churn for AcmeFinance.

-- Aisha
